mainEntity.name: What does moving and storage include?

acceptedAnswer.text: A move with a storage interval between move-out and move-in: packing, loading, a hold in leased storage, then redelivery and room-by-room placement — one coordinated plan, quoted flat in writing.

mainEntity.name: What kinds of items can be stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any type of items — including containers, household goods, and machines such as robotic arms. That scope statement and those examples are the item scope stated here.

mainEntity.name: Can I access my items while they are stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — customers can access their stored items while stored.

mainEntity.name: How does the move side work?

acceptedAnswer.text: As published on the residential page: whole-home and apartment moves, loading, transport and unloading, furniture protection and careful placement, disassembly and reassembly planned up front, full, partial, or fragile-only packing plus unpacking, white-glove care for antiques and high-value pieces, and custom crates when a piece needs more than padding.

mainEntity.name: How do I get a flat rate quote for a move with storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Get My Flat Rate Quote — Short (Quick Quote) by default, or Detailed Project, switching in place with From, To, and What's moving preserved. The pill button reads "Get a flat rate quote". Request a quote to confirm storage pricing for your dates and items.

mainEntity.name: What if the move includes a very heavy item?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the move involves a high-mass asset in the 1,500–3,500 lb range, that item moves under Structural Integrity Relocation (SIR), with floor deflection analysis to L/360, as part of the same flat-rate move.

mainEntity.name: Is this the same as warehouse or transload staging?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Warehouse relocation and transloading stage freight for onward shipment. Moving and storage holds your items between move-out and move-in. The two services are distinct and are never blurred on this page.

mainEntity.name: What about pianos, safes, or antiques in storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Specialty pieces move under their own categories — piano and antique moving, gun-safe moving under SIR, custom crating — cross-referenced here, never duplicated. Ask about a specialty piece when you request a quote.

mainEntity.name: What does storage typically cost, and how does access usually work?

acceptedAnswer.text: See "Storage, explained" above: industry pricing and access models are listed there for education, labeled as industry figures and models — never as our prices or our rules. Our own storage is quoted per job, monthly, or by volume; our minimum stay (30 days) and customer access are stated above.
